description: This file is a C header (.h) file that declares an interface for the ssp_messagebus_module, including function prototypes for engaging with the message bus, initialization, finalization, and resource management.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Engages or connects the module to the message bus with specified component ID, configuration file, and path.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the message bus interface with provided user-specific data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up the message bus interface with provided user-specific data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Performs a check on the message bus state or connectivity with provided user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the message bus interface, given a priority level and user data.
